infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NairaClinic uses your camera so your doctor can see you during a video consultation.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NairaClinic uses your microphone so your doctor can hear you during a consultation.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: NairaClinic uses Bluetooth so you can use headphones during a consultation.

plugins.photosPermission: NairaClinic uses your photos so you can choose a profile picture.
plugins.cameraPermission: NairaClinic uses your camera so you can take a profile picture.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: NairaClinic uses your location to find pharmacies and laboratories close to you.

plugins.calendarPermission: NairaClinic adds your medicine and care reminders to your calendar so you never miss one.

plugins.faceIDPermission: NairaClinic uses Face ID to keep your health records locked.
NairaClinic uses Face ID so you can open the app without typing your PIN.
